name: context-canvas-visual-verification
description: Selects proportionate visual and browser evidence for Context Canvas visitor-surface changes. Applies when layout, CSS, responsive behavior, interaction state, print, forced colors, or a visible regression needs review.

contract.what: A source-bound visual and browser observation that answers one Context Canvas visitor-surface question.
when: A change can alter composition, responsive behavior, interaction state, alternate presentation, or a route's visible fingerprint.
boundaries: Authored source and accepted contracts own intended behavior. Screenshots support comparison rather than pixel approval. Initial-state sweeps leave interaction behavior open. Prototype and iframe-document interiors retain their separate owners.
contract.result: The smallest fitting reference or focused check, an interpreted result, coverage and environment limits, and one next receiver.

receivingUse.job: A change can alter composition, responsive behavior, interaction state, alternate presentation, or a route's visible fingerprint.
receivingUse.materialResult: The smallest fitting reference or focused check, an interpreted result, coverage and environment limits, and one next receiver.
receivingUse.completion: The receiving collaborator can locate the semantic source, work within its boundaries, and recognize the material result.

standing.evidenceMaturity: Repository-maintained portable contract with source-specific, revisable material-use evidence.
standing.wakeTrigger: Material use, human correction, receiving-artifact behavior, or independent evidence changes this route.

transferBoundary: This projection carries repository-local instruction yield. Current intent, repository evidence, and granted tool authority govern each activation.
